title: Clean delivery: stop at done
story: An agent adds CSV export to a synthetic reporting tool. All three acceptance items pass, one out-of-scope idea is deferred instead of built, and the task stops the moment acceptance is met instead of 'polishing'.

envelope.north_star: Owners can export the weekly report as CSV
acceptance: AC3 empty week exports a header row

events.note: Verify totals against the on-screen report.

events.summary: PDF export would also be nice
